# New TunePad cell
def subBass(note, beats): # create a sub-bass function
    # play the note across three octaves for the specified beats
    # velocity 100 makes the sound loud
    playNote([note, note - 12, note - 24], beats = beats, velocity = 100) 
    rewind(beats - 0.1)  # move the playback position backwards slightly
    playNote(note, beats = beats - 0.1, velocity = 40)  # replay the original note quietly for slightly less time
    
notes = [ 45, 45, 45, 48, 40,40, 40 ] 
beats = [ 1, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 1.25, 0.5, 0.5 ]

for n, b in zip(notes, beats):
    subBass(n, b)

notes = [ 41, 41, 41, 41, 40, 40 ]
beats = [ 1, 0.75, 0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5 ]
